name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program that demonstrates
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Qiskit program that demonstrates violation of the CHSH inequality using a Bell state and StatevectorEstimator with measurement angles 0, pi/2 for Alice and pi/4, -pi/4 for Bob. Print the CHSH value S and verify S > 2. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
